supersedes_reason: The 318-island independent stress test did not support extreme mainland/continent isolation as a universal amplifier of source-pool information. The next fresh hypothesis therefore separates external geographic isolation from species-specific internal source isolation instead of treating remoteness as a universal regime switch.

ecological_model.name: dual_isolation_source_pool
ecological_model.statement: Island isolation has at least two ecologically distinct axes: external isolation from major source landmasses and internal isolation from the focal species' occupied insular source pool. Species occurrence may retain information from internal source isolation after external isolation and current island state are represented.
ecological_model.external_isolation: response-independent geographic and historical separation from major external source landmasses
ecological_model.internal_source_isolation: training-only species-conditioned scarcity or discontinuity of occupied insular sources available to the focal island
ecological_model.archipelago_permeability: response-independent physical ease with which islands in an archipelago can act as stepping stones or exchange partners
ecological_model.key_distinction: A geographically remote island can be source-rich internally, and a geographically near island can be source-poor for a particular species. These states must not be collapsed to one distance-to-mainland axis.

R0: biogeographic region or archipelago structure if predeclared
R1_add: other prospectively frozen classical island-state variables
R3_add: training-only nearest occupied source distance when safe geometry permits
training-only diffuse/multi-source pressure when safe geometry permits
C_add: training-only species-conditioned internal source-pool continuity not reducible to the R3 direct/diffuse source terms

primary_prediction.name: internal_source_isolation_is_nonredundant
primary_prediction.estimand: cluster-weighted mean candidate-minus-R3 held-out log loss across the full prospectively eligible test population
primary_prediction.support_rule: point estimate < 0 and prospectively frozen cluster-bootstrap 95% upper confidence limit < 0
primary_prediction.interpretation_if_supported: Species-specific internal source isolation carries predictive occurrence information beyond external isolation, island state, generic archipelago structure, global occupancy breadth and direct/diffuse occupied-source context.

external_isolation_rule.forbidden_primary: do not require or rescue support by showing a stronger candidate gain in an extreme-isolation tail
external_isolation_rule.q75_or_other_tail_checks: descriptive sensitivity only unless a future system-specific directional interaction was justified and frozen independently before response access

archipelago_permeability.prediction: incremental internal-source information is stronger where physical archipelago permeability is higher, because occupied insular sources are more plausibly accessible
archipelago_permeability.required_freeze: operator, scale rule and moderator contrast before any response access

dispersal_mode.source: external taxonomy/trait source frozen before response access
dispersal_mode.prediction: present occupied-source continuity is relatively more informative for higher-dispersal taxa, while historical connection is relatively more informative for lower-dispersal taxa

source_saturation.prediction: incremental internal-source information attenuates as global occupied breadth increases because broad species have more saturated source support

anti_selection: A-Islands cannot count as confirmation because it generated the source-pool hypothesis
the completed 318-island mammal stress response cannot be re-analysed for subgroup or threshold rescue
the Indo-Pacific atoll plant response cannot be repaired or rerun
the pristine 5,592-island mammal system is not admitted merely because it is large; safe geography and full pre-response contracts must first be frozen
a future system cannot be selected because a published or previewed result is favourable
external-isolation thresholds cannot be promoted to a primary after response access
permeability and dispersal-mode moderators must be frozen before response access
one secondary moderator cannot rescue a failed overall primary

minimum_fresh_confirmation.stronger_generalization: replication in at least two independently admitted island systems with distinct archipelago geometry or taxonomic dispersal regimes
